memories.content: The French Presidency is responsible for managing the COP21 climate conference. It aims to produce a consolidated draft agreement text that can be circulated to national delegations. It has the authority to prepare and circulate such texts.

The COP21 climate conference is taking place in Paris from November 30 to December 11, 2015. The final scheduled day of the summit is December 11, 2015. The French Presidency is expected to facilitate negotiations and may circulate draft texts.
